objective: Bind the syntactic transfer and source admission to both listed and fixed catalogues; reconstruct an actual guarded refutation with a product of distinct surviving source variables and give stage and input-bit rates.
status: Proved: With high probability the induced guarded formulas require exp(Ω(r)) refutation nodes in the listed encoding and exp(Ω(r^(1/3))) on a fixed catalogue of r stages, even with degree-two multiplication over F2. Both encodings admit an explicit checked nonlinear proof replay.
title: An exponential route proof bound with live mixed products
